This is a guide for begginers to start in Graveryard Keeper 2.
The main idea is to show possible steps that can be missed and can be source of doubts or being stucked in some parts of the game.
==Start==

! Step !! Image !! Action !! Notes

| What the... || [[File:What the... box.png|alt=What the...|thumb]] || You have to click on the text box || Usually you have several choices to answer or make a question, but at the very start of the game you only have one option
|-
| Equip Pickaxe || [[File:Equip Pickaxe.png|alt=Equip pickaxe|thumb]] || Click on TAB to access to your inventory, then left click on the pickaxe or right click + Equip ||
|-
| Use Mushroom || [[File:Use Mushroom.png|alt=Use Mushroom|thumb]] || Click on TAB to access to your inventory, then left click on the mushroom or right click + Use ||
|}
